title: CSP operations portal
summary: Connects account managers' work with Partner Center: access, costs, licenses and purchases for the whole portfolio in one read-only place.
lead: One place to see access, costs, licenses and purchases across the whole client portfolio.
problem: The information an account manager needs to serve a client was spread across different portals. Answering something simple, like how many licenses are paid for but unused, took time and depended on who knew where to look.
idea: Bring everything into one portal that reads Microsoft's sources without being able to change them, shows each person only what they should see, and requires double approval before any purchase.
change: The team checks the whole portfolio in one place, spots unassigned licenses and renewals in time, and every purchase is logged and approved.
role: I gathered requirements with the account managers, defined the scope and role-based permissions, designed the screens, built the read-only Microsoft integrations, set up the double-approval purchase flow and shipped it to production on Azure.
note: I show the what and the why. Code and client data stay inside Readymind.
